description:
About the Position

Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) is hiring a PhD-TA in statistics with a focus on functional data analysis. The position combines 80 percent doctoral research with 20 percent teaching-assistant duties in the Statistics research group of the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science.

Functional data analysis develops statistical methods for data that are functions, curves or signals, arising in sensor streams, biomedical monitoring, energy systems and industrial processes. The doctoral project develops methodology in this area, with applications shaped by the group's collaborations. The teaching component covers tutoring in statistics courses, supervising student projects and supporting the department's quantitative curriculum.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a master's degree in statistics, mathematics or a closely related quantitative field and show solid foundations in probability, statistical inference and computational statistics. Good communication skills are important because of the teaching component, which also makes the position suitable for candidates considering an academic career. The appointment follows the Dutch CAO-NU collective agreement with a starting salary on the national PhD scale and the standard four-year doctoral contract structure at TU/e.

Highlights

  • Functional data analysis methodology
  • Statistical modelling of curves, signals and sensor data
  • Computational statistics and inference
  • Teaching-assistant duties (20% of the role)
  • Applications across biomedical and industrial domains
  • Four-year PhD-TA track under the CAO-NU agreement
